title: Provenance Tracking (Taint Analysis) for Tracing Sabotage

original_idea.body:
# Provenance Tracking (Taint Analysis) for Tracing Sabotage Through Agent Trajectories

**Problem:** When a monitor flags a harmful action, it's hard to know which earlier step planted it. Without provenance, blue teams can't tell single-act from multi-step attacks.

**Direction:** Adapt dynamic taint analysis. Instrument a sandboxed agent so each state is tagged with the actions that produced it; when harm occurs, back-trace the taint chain. On SHADE-Arena attacks, measure how far back the sabotage seed is and whether taint chains distinguish single vs multi-step.

**Why it matters:** Enables targeted rollback and supports the concentrated-vs-distributed distinction. Reusable infrastructure, no training.

**Relevant context:** Dynamic taint analysis; UK AISI ai_control context; Ctrl-Z (arXiv:2504.10374).
